title: AWS CLI v1
summary: The workstation has AWS CLI v1 (1.45.64), which rejects --no-cli-pager; cloudctl appended it to every aws command, so every ed209d call failed. Since v0.2-dev1 no flag is added: each aws command runs with AWS_PAGER set empty in its own environment, which v1 ignores and v2 honours. Tests check every aws call has AWS_PAGER empty and none carries --no-cli-pager.
